decision: User decision 2026-09-17: canonical SFS (hard) and SCORE on the cloud grid (Qwen 6/7/8/8.3 QPS x 16,000; Ministral 6.0125/7.8625/8.7875 QPS x 8,000) with the flag-gated remaining-length rule ON for qwen3-0.6b only (running_all, q0.5, prompt_bin); qwen3-8b, qwen3-32b and all Ministral engines keep the current rule. Rules and table hashes are bound to every qualification and completed-ledger entry through campaign_sha256 and instances.json.

qwen-hard-8.rule: The worker skips a cell only when <state>/completed/<cell id>.json exists, belongs to this bundle and its source pin is the current one or an accepted prior digest. Both lane controls ran under source 09b0478 with the current rule (flag OFF) and with the pre-thread arrival producer; reusing either mixes rules and source lineages with the rule-ON cells of this overlay. Nothing is written automatically: if the user still decides to reuse one, they write the ledger entry and add its source digest to accepted_prior_source_digests with the reason; otherwise the cell is rerun like the others.

score_lambda_evidence.basis: 2,000-request probes at 7 QPS on the canonical Qwen pool, all four scored at the campaign's own 5e-4 so the levels are comparable: TTFT SLO attainment 9.70 / 77.35 / 97.30 / 98.25 % and Pro OnTimeUtility 0.0571 / 0.3055 / 0.3056 / 0.2750
score_lambda_evidence.decision: 5e-2 for every SCORE cell of the campaign (user decision, 18 September 2026). 5e-3 ties it on utility but leaves a 62 s p90 TTFT; 5e-1 sends 92 % of traffic to the 0.6B. SCORE's multiplier is a published tuning knob, so it is tuned once and never again; the objective every method is scored on stays at the bundle's 5e-4.

remaining_length.note: The rule is per engine: only the qwen3-0.6b server receives --remaining-length-mode running_all --remaining-length-table qwen3-0.6b.json --remaining-length-quantile 0.5 --remaining-length-conditioning prompt_bin, and the router attaches that table for its missing-prediction fill on that instance only. qwen3-8b and qwen3-32b stay off: reserve-tail-20260916 README sections 4.2/4.3 (8B target component within noise, hindsight replay worse under every candidate; 32B sub-second either way). Ministral stays off: no Ministral paired evidence (reserve-tail-ministral-20260917 is analysis only), the rule is only plumbed for the Qwen family and scripts.cloud.pool refuses it for a Ministral server. Tables were built from the calibration outputs only (zero overlap with the 16,000 evaluation ids); manifest.json records the build paths on the controller.

evidence.paired_run: scripts/cloud/reports/reserve-tail-20260916/paired-qps8p6-on/result_summary.json (Vast /workspace/sfs/state/diagnostics/reserve-tail-20260916/paired-qps8p6-on; canonical 8.6 QPS hard control, 16,000 requests, source bedeec4 + reserve diff)
evidence.reading: ON exceeds the better OFF control on both acceptance metrics (attainment 90.89 vs 63.71 percent; Pro OnTimeUtility 0.4732 vs 0.3561), outside the 13.8-point OFF spread; the pre-registered reading rule in the readiness note therefore admits the 0.6B rule for the campaign.
